channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: San Diego Airport access roads reopen after flooding, flight delays possible
item.description: All airport access roadways at San Diego International Airport have reopened following flooding that temporarily closed routes to the facility, Airport Authority Chair Gil Cabrera announced on X Thursday morning.

item.title: Thousands without power in Mid-City, Clairemont areas amid heavy rains
item.description: Nearly 4,400 residents in several San Diego neighborhoods were without power Thursday morning as heavy rains moved through the area, according to San Diego Gas & Electric.

item.title: Flooding closes roads, prompts travel warnings across San Diego County
item.description: Heavy rains caused widespread roadway flooding across San Diego County Thursday, prompting closures, cautions and detours from Oceanside to National City, authorities said.

item.title: Opinion: California needs both clean energy and a nuclear-power backstop
item.description: A fleet of advanced reactors running around the clock can provide reliable, carbon-free electricity to backstop solar and wind.

item.title: Lifeguards rescue adult, child trapped in car in Fashion Valley
item.description: A San Diego Lifeguard Swift Water Rescue team rescued an adult and a child trapped in a vehicle by rapidly rising flood waters Thursday at the Fashion Valley mall.

item.title: Sig Alert issued after big rig jackknifes on I-15 in Mission Valley
item.description: A semi tractor-trailer hydroplaned during heavy rains Thursday, crashed into a center divider and jack-knifed, blocking the right three lanes of traffic on northbound Interstate 15 and prompting a Sig Alert just south of Interstate 8.

item.title: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance wins Grand Marshal Award at 137th Rose Parade
item.description: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance's elephant-themed float won the Grand Marshal Award for most outstanding creative concept and design at the 137th Rose Parade Thursday.

item.title: City of San Diego activates inclement weather shelters as rain continues
item.description: Ongoing rainy weather has prompted the city of San Diego to activate its inclement weather shelter program for a second consecutive day Thursday.

item.title: ‘Turn around, don’t drown’: Sheriff’s officials urge public to avoid flooded areas following rescues
item.description: San Diego County fire and law enforcement crews carried out two flood-related rescues Thursday as heavy rains swelled waterways across the region on New Year’s Day.

item.title: King tides could bring more coastal flooding Friday through Sunday
item.description: King Tides expected in the next two days may cause additional coastal flooding, especially with chances of showers extending through the weekend, the city of San Diego warned Thursday.
